# JacobsthalQuadratic — the quadratic bound on Jacobsthal's function

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** outside source: proved in Lean in another project · **Diagram:** [Gaps between survivors and between primes](../../GRAPH.md#gaps-between-survivors-and-between-primes)

Every run of consecutive integers longer than a constant times the square of k contains a number coprime to any given number with at most k prime factors. Proved in Lean by OpenAI (September 2026); solves Erdős Problem 970.
